notes_for_editor: The only evidence for this tower is a county name in the Forest Lookouts directory, repeated in its Florida index. No register (NHLR or FFLOS) in the local cache lists a tower here, and two web searches found nothing on a San Mateo tower. Nothing says whether it was built, who ran it, or whether it stands. The story is shorter than the 120-word target because the sources have nothing more to add. A check of Putnam County or Florida Forest Service records, or Palatka newspapers, could add a build date and fate. Record coordinates (29.59851, -81.57325) were not checked against a map.
